subject: SOC 2 & ISO audit RFP — shortlist review, SOW redlines, and contracting timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Amy Bloom <amy.bloom@brightline-audits.com>, vendor@northbridge.co <vendor@northbridge.co>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 & ISO audit RFP — shortlist + requested timeline

Team / vendors,

Thanks for the responses to the RFP. Attached is the shortlist scorecard (RFP-shortlist-scorecard.xlsx) — runbook below for next steps so we can lock a partner before year-end. High-level asks:

- Goal: pick primary audit partner for SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 annual renewal (contract effective Jan 1).
- Decision window: final vendor selected by end of week (Tuesday 11/24) so procurement can start PO and DocuSign routing.
- Legal asks: Redline SOW for data retention, subprocessor list, and liability cap. We prefer one-year term with auto-renew opt-out.

Brightline attached an initial draft SOW (Brightline_SOW_v1.1.pdf); NorthBridge said they'll send a redline by Monday. Im copying Laura for legal language and Markus for budget sign-off. Monica: any constraints from CS/Platform we should call out?

Please review scorecard + attached SOW. Priorities for selection: expertise with high-throughput inference platforms, minimal on-site work (hybrid OK), and clear evidence-handling procedures for customer data.

Action items:
1) Internal: quick read by EOD Mon (11/23) — highlight any must-have redlines.
2) Vendors: submit redlined SOW and standard PO terms by Mon 11/23 5pm PT.
3) Legal (Laura): if initial redlines are acceptable, prepare a procurement-ready SOW summary.

Attachments: RFP-shortlist-scorecard.xlsx, Brightline_SOW_v1.1.pdf

--
Aditya Rao
Head of Trust & Safety Operations
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Bloom <amy.bloom@brightline-audits.com>, vendor@northbridge.co <vendor@northbridge.co>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 & ISO audit RFP — shortlist + requested timeline

Aditya —

Thanks, looks good. Quick notes from CS:
- Brightline has done inference platform audits for two references we vetted (names in the scorecard) which is a plus.
- Please confirm theres a clause for no customer data extraction beyond scoped artifacts and a clear incident escalation timeline (48 hours).

Im leaning Brightline but want legal to review redlines first. Markus, any budget objections?

Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Amy Bloom <amy.bloom@brightline-audits.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Brightline — redlined SOW & DocuSign link

Aditya / team,

Appreciate the shortlist and call yesterday. Attached is Brightline_SOW_v1.2_redline.pdf with our responses to the scope and proposed edits. Key points:
- We adjusted on-site days to 2 (initial scoping) and remote evidence collection thereafter to match your preference.
- Pricing: $78k for SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 audit (one-year engagement) with a 6% credit if you commit to a 2-year renewal upfront.
- Data handling: weve added a subprocessor appendix and propose a 45-day retention window for interim artifacts, full retention only on signed evidence agreed post-engagement.

DocuSign link for an expedited SOW: https://app.docusign.com/transaction/12345-brightline-sow

Attachments: Brightline_SOW_v1.2_redline.pdf

Let me know if your legal team needs us to accept a specific liability cap language or add audit-specific SLAs (were flexible). Happy to hop on a 30-min call Monday morning if that helps.

Best,
Amy Bloom
Head of Audit Partnerships
Brightline Audits Inc.
amy.bloom@brightline-audits.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Amy Bloom <amy.bloom@brightline-audits.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightline — redlined SOW & DocuSign link

Amy — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear amendments. A couple of legal asks before we route for signature:

- Liability cap: propose we limit to greater of $500k or 1x annual fee for breach-related damages; please confirm if Brightline can accept or provide counter.
- Data retention: Laura, please advise if 45-day interim artifact retention is acceptable vs our standard 30-day policy for short-lived evidence. If we need 30 days well request that change.
- Subprocessors: please enumerate the current subprocessor list in the appendix (if not already in v1.2).

Laura: could you take lead on a short annotated SOW summary that captures the redlines we need prior to procurement? If approved, Ill ask Procurement to open a PO and route the DocuSign envelope.

Aditya

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Bloom <amy.bloom@brightline-audits.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightline — redlined SOW & DocuSign link

Aditya / team,

Attached is SOW-annotated-summary.docx — I pulled the redlines and drafted recommended contract language for three items: liability cap, data retention, and subprocessor disclosure. Summary below:

- Liability cap: we recommend countering to "greater of $500,000 or 1x annual fee" limited to direct damages; carveouts for willful misconduct and gross negligence remain unlimited.
- Data retention: reduce Brightlines proposed 45-day interim artifact retention to 30 days for all non-signed evidence; allow exceptions only by documented approval and with encryption-at-rest evidence.
- Subprocessors: require Brightline to provide an initial list in the appendix and notify us within 10 business days of any changes plus right to object for high-risk subprocessors.

If youre all aligned, Ill prepare a short SOW markup that Procurement can attach to the DocuSign envelope and we can route for signature. Also recommend we adopt an annual renewal cadence with a 30-day notice to opt-out — that keeps vendor management light and matches our forecasting cycle.

Can I have a thumbs-up by EOD today so I can finalize the markup?

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
